title: Vector Search and Slides
description: Vector search enhances knowledge base searches by representing data (text, images, videos) as numerical vectors, capturing semantic meaning rather than relying solely on keyword matching. By transforming information into dense vector representations, vector search allows for more nuanced retrieval based on context and similarity. This means users can retrieve relevant content even if their query doesn’t contain exact words or phrases from the database. Whether it’s a text article, image, or video, vector search can match semantically related content, offering more accurate and contextually relevant results, which is especially useful for large, diverse knowledge bases.
